title: F07: Name normalisation, category lookup table + seed, duplicates
milestone: M4 Domain logic
labels: backend
---
## Goal
Normalise item names, categorise them by lookup, remember user choices and detect duplicate receipts.

**Depends on:** F02 (parallel with F03, F04)
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Normaliser tests cover real receipt strings, e.g. `BIO BANANE 1 KG → banane`
- [ ] A user's category choice is saved and used on the next receipt
- [ ] Duplicate detection is tested
